t: This statue of Achilles, standing on a mound at the south-western end of Park Lane, is the Wellington Monument. It was put up as a memorial to the Duke of Wellington and his victories in the Peninsular War and the later stages of the Napoleonic Wars. It was inaugurated on 18 June 1822. With its base and mound it stands about eleven metres high. The sculptor was Sir Richard Westmacott.
